title: Annealed traffic-gradient controller with cohort smoke validation
author: Maya Lopez
description:
Motivation: progressive canaries + A/B experiments at Redwood currently use stepwise traffic increments with static holdpoints. For workloads where signal-to-noise ratio decays slowly we saw either long rollouts or too-frequent rollbacks. This PR adds an "annealed traffic-gradient controller" that adjusts traffic ramp rate per-cohort based on an online confidence estimate and a short 'cohort smoke' validation phase before integrating traffic metrics into SLO gates.

Design summary: the controller exposes a new rollout strategy type (strategy: 'annealed_gradient') that: 1) assigns target cohorts (percent buckets) and a per-cohort initial ramp_rate; 2) runs a lightweight cohort smoke validation (synthetic queries or small real-traffic shadowing) for a configurable window (default 30s) to bootstrap a confidence score; 3) uses an exponential decay on the confidence signal while ramping traffic so that early instability yields slower ramps but stable cohorts accelerate automatically; 4) integrates with existing safety gates (latency, error-rate, quality regression) and supports immediate drain/rollback if thresholds are breached.

Config changes and API: added RolloutStrategy schema extension: "annealed_gradient": {"initial_step_pct","min_step_pct","max_step_pct","cohort_smoke": {"enabled","duration_s","synthetic_profile"},"confidence_decay_half_life_s"}. Exposed via the same rollout CRD and Redwood Console UI. Backwards compatible: existing strategies unaffected.

Implementation notes: core logic implemented in rollout/controller/annealed_gradient_controller.go with a separate confidence estimator module (rollout/estimator/confidence.go). Lightweight smoke harness implemented in rollout/smoke/runner.go which can be toggled to only shadow traffic for Private deployments. New observability metrics: rollout_cohort_confidence{rollout_id,cohort}, rollout_smoke_pass_ratio, rollout_ramp_rate_pct. Added tracing spans for smoke->gate evaluation path.

Testing: unit tests for estimator and smoke harness (rollout/estimator/*, rollout/smoke/*), integration test that runs an end-to-end simulated A/B with a flaky latency generator to verify ramp deceleration and rollback detection (integration/annealed_gradient_sim_test.go). Manual QA: staged on dedicated QA cluster using an experimental rollout (linear ENG-4823 test plan).

Migration and rollout: feature-flagged under "annealedGradient". Default off for production customers; set to on for internal canaries and opt-in customers. No migration steps required for existing rollout records.

Checklist:
- [x] Controller implementation
- [x] Config schema + API surface
- [x] Unit & integration tests
- [x] Console UI stub + docs note
- [x] Metrics & tracing
- [x] Feature flag gating

Related work: builds on prior cohort-aware controllers and safe-holdpoint logic (see ENG-2712 and PRs for staged-rollouts). See linked Linear ENG-4823 for experiment matrix and expected SLO behavior.

Risk notes: the smoke harness performs short synthetic traffic; if customers opt into synthetic profiles without rate limits it could add noise — defaults are conservative. Confidence estimator uses rolling windows so there is potential for slow adaptation on very low-traffic cohorts; documented in release notes.

How to exercise locally: makefile target 'make test-integration-rollout' runs harness + local simulator; console toggles available on feature flags page.

Merge notes: squash-merge, update release notes with an example rollout YAML and a migration paragraph.

review_comments: Arjun Patel: Nice addition — can you add a short comment on why exponential decay was chosen vs 1/t? Also add a unit test for the half-life behavior.
Maya Lopez: Reply: exponential decay chosen to give tunable memory (half-life) and simpler parameterization for operators. Added test half_life_test.go covering expected behavior.

Lena Fischer: Request change: surface a max_synthetic_qps cap in smoke harness config to avoid accidental load.
Maya Lopez: ACK, added max_smoke_qps with default 5 and a validation check in API layer.
Diego Marquez: Approve after CI passes and docs updated.
release_notes: Introduce 'annealed_gradient' rollout strategy: supports cohort smoke validation and confidence-decay-driven ramping to reduce unnecessary rollouts/rollbacks. Feature-flagged behind 'annealedGradient' and disabled by default. See docs/rollouts/annealed-gradient.md for examples.
notes_for_ops: Feature is disabled by default; enable per-cluster via feature-flag. Watch rollout_cohort_confidence and rollout_smoke_pass_ratio metrics for initial deployments. Ensure cluster allows smoke harness qps (default cap 5).
